description: The hooks of Kestrel, and the mod that draws the Kestrel pane in Claude Code

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/cli/kestrel.mjs" hook compact-keep --plugin 2>/dev/null; exit 0
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/cli/kestrel.mjs" hook cold-start --plugin 2>/dev/null; exit 0
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/cli/kestrel.mjs" hook model-switch --plugin 2>/dev/null; exit 0
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/cli/kestrel.mjs" hook refresh-copy --plugin 2>/dev/null; exit 0
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/cli/kestrel.mjs" hook check-settings --plugin 2>/dev/null; exit 0
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/cli/kestrel.mjs" hook check-turn --plugin 2>/dev/null; exit 0
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/cli/kestrel.mjs" hook push-gate --plugin 2>/dev/null; exit 0
